label: PF Backlog 595
title: Backlog API: doc-driven context ingest - POST /backlog/epics/{id}/context:from-doc (project a plan .md onto an epic + children; dry-run default)
body: Feed a decision/plan markdown doc and project its sections onto the epic + its children's context fields so re-grooming/regrooming references the ORIGINAL doc instead of re-inventing. Format: headings '## <BI-PF-id> ...' + 'field: value' lines / bullet lists; whitelisted context fields only. Default apply=false -> per-item preview of changed fields; apply=true writes via core.backlog.update (single writer) and stamps links.source_doc + links.context_doc_sha (idempotent re-apply). doc_path must resolve inside repo root. language-rule: governed exemption for api/routers/backlog.py (BI-PF-1396).

objective: Tooling CLI to ingest a plan/design document (.md/.txt/.doc/.docx/.pdf/.rtf) and project its sections onto an epic + children, updating any writable field (context, editable, dependencies) via the backlog API.
acceptance_criteria: dry-run lists per-item changed fields, writes nothing
--apply writes only doc-supplied fields; revision bumps
writes via API; unit test covers parser+mapping+diff
out_of_scope: HTTP endpoint in api/ (would need Go + bridge)
approach: scripts/dev/backlog_ingest_doc.py (tooling Python) reuses core.intake_files.extract for text; parses '## <BI-PF-id>' sections + 'field: value'/bullets; routes fields to POST /items/{id}/context, PATCH /items/{id}, POST /items/{id}/dependencies; upsert (fill-missing default, --overwrite, --create). API-only single writer; dry-run default.
verification: Objective achieved: Backlog API: doc-driven context ingest - POST /backlog/epics/{id}/context:from-doc (project a plan .md onto an epic + children; dry-run default)

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend api/routers/backlog.py with POST /backlog/epics/{id}/context:from-doc. Reuse core/backlog.py (update path) as single writer, core/backlog_link.py for links.source_doc + links.context_doc_sha stamps, core/context_policy.py + config/context-policy.json for field whitelist. New markdown parsing helper (headings '## <BI-PF-id>', 'field: value', bullets) lives in the router or a small core helper; default dry-run preview, apply=true writes idempotently.

analysis.rationale: The endpoint composes existing primitives (backlog update, link stamping, context policy) with only a new parsing/projection layer, so EXTEND is the minimal reuse-first path.
assumptions: core/backlog.py update is the enforced single writer for context fields
